title: recoverRuns writes the run map under the manager lock
lead: Before S78, recoverRuns (internal/daemon/runs.go:164-232) wrote d.runs.runs in its loop (:180-227) without the manager lock, then took the lock only for startQueuedLocked (:228-230). Startup calls recoverRuns before the server starts (internal/daemon/daemon.go:175). Noted in the S05 run report.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Every other write to the run map happens under d.runs.mu. A later change that calls recoverRuns after the server starts would race.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/runs.go:164-232`: `recoverRuns`, including all five run-map assignment paths.
- `internal/daemon/runs_test.go:1553-1606`: `TestRecoverRunsWritesTheRunMapUnderTheLock`, alongside recovery tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `TestRecoverRunsWritesTheRunMapUnderTheLock`: under `go test -race`, read the run map under `d.runs.mu` while `recoverRuns` publishes registered queued, reconciled, failed-reconciliation, removed queued, and removed active runs. Each case must report a race before the fix and pass afterward. Remove each publication lock in turn and confirm its case reports a race.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Take d.runs.mu around each write to d.runs.runs in the recoverRuns loop (internal/daemon/runs.go:180-227), not around Reconcile (:217; it can be slow). Write the race test first, watch it fail under -race, then add the lock. Decided 2026-10-23 (owner interview): take the lock. Nothing is open.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/daemon/...`
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` (prints nothing)
- `slicer check`
- `adj lint`
